metadata.title: About Andy Sinker
metadata.description: Meet Andy Sinker ADI, M Imst MTD — Managing Director and Lead Trainer at Andy Sinker Driving School. Multi-award winning driving instructor and GoRoadie's Driving Instructor of the Year for England 2026.

hero.title: Andy Sinker ADI, M Imst MTD
hero.subtitle: Managing Director and Lead Trainer

paragraphs: Andy is passionate about helping learner drivers, experienced motorists looking to improve their skills and trainee driving instructors achieve their goals.

As a proud member of the Institute of Master Tutors of Driving and holder of Tri-Coaching BTEC level 4 in Coaching for Driver Development, Andy is currently partaking in Bright Coaching's Professional Diploma in Coaching for Driving Instructors. Andy is dedicated to continuous personal and professional development. He regularly updates his knowledge and skills to ensure that every learner and instructor receives the highest standard of training and support throughout their driving journey.
biography.imageAlt: Andy Sinker leaning on his driving school car

featuredAward.title: GoRoadie Driving Instructor of the Year — England 2026
featuredAward.body: Recognised as one of the UK's top driving instructors, Andy was honoured to receive the GoRoadie's Driving Instructor of the Year Award for England in 2026, recognising his commitment to excellence in driver training.
featuredAward.imageAlt: GoRoadie Awards 2026 — Driving Instructor of the Year England — Andy Sinker

recognition.title: Intelligent Instructor Awards
recognition.body: Andy has been ranked among the Top 100 Driving Instructors in the country for the Intelligent Instructor Awards. In 2023, he received a Highly Commended award for the Yorkshire and Humber region, followed by Silver Awards in both 2025 and 2026.
